metadata.metaDescription: DXG provides event production management for corporate, association, medical, nonprofit and education events, bringing budget, vendors, schedule and show flow into one plan.
metadata.author: Digital Xperience Group (DXG)

images.title: Event Production Stage & Setup
images.alt: DXG Event Production Management Stage & Setup with HD LED walls and lighting
images.caption: Professional event stage setup featuring LED video walls, dynamic lighting, and FOH production table.

seo.imageTitle: DXG Corporate Event Stage & Production Setup
seo.description: High-impact visual of general session stage setup with full LED video display and FOH production command center.

images.creativeBrief: Wide corporate general session stage, high-definition LED video wall displaying custom event graphics, stage lighting in white and cyan, front-of-house tech table.

images.title: Producer at front of house
images.alt: DXG event producer directing live conference show flow at front of house tech table
images.caption: Over-the-shoulder perspective from behind the DXG producer managing run-of-show cues live during a major conference.

seo.imageTitle: DXG Producer Directing Live Event Front of House
seo.description: Over-the-shoulder view of DXG producer at the tech table with headset on, run of show tablet active, directing general session.

images.creativeBrief: Over-the-shoulder from behind the DXG producer at the tech table: headset on, run of show on a tablet, hand raised mid-cue. Beyond them, a wide general session stage lit in white and cool blue, audience heads in soft focus. Low key, one dominant light source.

images.title: Planner and producer, venue crew behind
images.alt: Event planner and DXG production manager reviewing floor plan during venue setup
images.caption: DXG producer and meeting planner collaborating calmly over room floor plans while in-house venue crew operates in the background.

seo.imageTitle: Planner & DXG Producer Collaborating During Ballroom Load-in
seo.description: Meeting planner and DXG producer reviewing floor plans in ballroom foreground while venue AV crew sets stage.

images.creativeBrief: Ballroom during load-in. A meeting planner and the DXG producer stand together over a floor plan or tablet in the foreground, engaged and calm. Behind them, a venue in-house crew in their own uniforms flies a screen or sets a stage.

images.title: Technical site visit
images.alt: Technical site visit measuring ballroom ceiling rigging points and sightlines
images.caption: DXG technical producer assessing ballroom ceiling rigging points, power access, and sightlines ahead of load-in.

seo.imageTitle: DXG Technical Site Visit & Ballroom Inspection
seo.description: Empty ballroom inspection by DXG technical producer evaluating ceiling rigging points and space dimensions.

images.creativeBrief: Empty ballroom, chairs stacked, the producer with a laser measure or pointing at a rigging point on the ceiling. Wide, slightly low angle, lots of ceiling.

images.title: Technical speaker rehearsal
images.alt: Speaker rehearsal on stage with confidence monitors and production crew
images.caption: Keynote speaker conducting technical rehearsal on stage with confidence monitors and FOH crew testing timing.

seo.description: Presenter testing stage movement and timing during pre-show controlled rehearsal with DXG tech team.

images.creativeBrief: A presenter on stage under half house lights, confidence monitor visible, crew at the tech table in the foreground with the run of show open. Quiet, focused.

images.title: Live show day keynote session
images.alt: Live event general session keynote with bright LED display wall and engaged audience
images.caption: High-energy show day moment as the general session keynote begins with a vibrant LED backdrop and full audience.

seo.imageTitle: Live Show Day Execution & General Session Keynote
seo.description: Full general session viewed from back of house as keynote commences with high-impact LED visuals.

images.creativeBrief: Full general session from the back of house at the moment a keynote begins: LED wall bright, audience seated, producer's silhouette at FOH in the bottom corner. High energy.

images.title: The second set of eyes (AV Proposal Audit)
images.alt: Detailed AV proposal audit review with highlighted notes and room diagram
images.caption: Line-by-line review of an AV proposal flagging scope gaps, crew hours, and pricing assumptions before contract signing.

seo.description: Overhead close-up of printed AV contract proposal with cyan margin notes, pen, and room diagram on laptop.

images.creativeBrief: Close, overhead: a printed AV proposal with cyan highlighter marks and margin notes, a pen, a laptop edge showing a room diagram. No faces. Tight crop, shallow depth of field.

images.title: Empty ballroom before load-in
images.alt: Quiet empty ballroom with equipment flight cases lined up before event load-in
images.caption: Cinematic shot of an empty ballroom the night before setup with equipment cases prepared for morning load-in.

seo.imageTitle: Empty Ballroom Prepared for Production Load-In
seo.description: Cinematic low-light ballroom shot showing equipment cases staged in doorway prior to show day setup.

images.creativeBrief: Empty ballroom the night before, one work light on, cases lined up in the doorway. Wide, dark, cinematic. Sits under a navy gradient so text stays readable.
